answer: Propose archive rewards for scans of crystal deposits in island karst. Each key retains a distinct 1-TB replica for 30 days. Validators randomly audit key-bound proofs of replication; missing or invalid proofs cancel monthly rewards. Sound proofs and deadlines shorter than regeneration are essential; fast regeneration breaks the storage bound. Disks are reusable capital; power recurs; no stake. This does not prove scan accuracy or unique ownership. Ten parallel keys still require 10 TB on shared hosts; wealthy operators can buy that capacity.
